newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Highlights of Thursday's Commission briefing.
newsitem.headline: Highlights of Thursday's Commission briefing.

text.p: Following are highlights of the midday briefing by the European Commission on Thursday:

Spokesman Jochen Kubosch said the Court of Justice had issued judgements on two requests for a preliminary ruling by German and Dutch courts. He said they concerned the application of directive 77/388/EEC on the harmonisation of member states' legislation on turnover tax.
Kubosch said the court had also recognised Belgium's failure to transpose within the prescribed period Council directive 92/42/EEC on the output of new liquid or gas burning water boilers.

In answer to a question, van der Pas said Georges Soros's meeting with Commission President Jacques Santer and Commissioner Hans van den Broek would go over Soros's ideas to expand information television and fund a new Univeristy in Eastern Europe.

Spokesman Joao Vale de Almeida confirmed the invitation of Ugandan President Yoweri Museveni, Kenyan President Daniel arap Moi and former Tanzanian President Julius Nyerere to meet Commissioner Joao de Deus Pinheiro in order to discuss the situation in the Great Lakes Region and in Sudan. He said they had accepted the invitation and would come in the next weeks or months .
The Commission released the following documents:
- IP/97/94: Palestinians in need: Commission approves humanitarian aid worth ECU 10 million.
- IP/97/95: Disaster preparedness: Commission approves funding worth over ECU 1.7 million.
- IP/97/96: Citizens' access to internal Commission documents: demand increases.
- Speech/97/29: Speech by Commissioner Franz Fischler on "forces for change in the European Union".
- Speech/97/30: Speech by Commissioner Mario Monti to the Luxembourg Parliament Foreign Affairs committee.
- Speech/97/31: Speech by Commissioner Mario Monti on "Eurostransit '97".
- Speech/97/32: Speech by Commissioner Yves-Thibault de Silguy at CBI Employers' Organisations and Trade Associations conference.
- Speech/97/33: Speech by Commissioner Yves-Thibault de Silguy at 1992 Club Network of Bucks and Oxon East.
- Taxes and duties at January 1997 in Ecus and national currencies.
